Essentials
Flights

Out: BA0186 Austin to Heathrow, September 21, 10:30 PM, lands 1:55 PM. BA0522 Heathrow to Florence 7:05 PM, lands 10:20 PM. Two bags at 32 kg. Home: October 16 on points, details to come.

Rental car

Avis #26405920US2. Fiat 600, automatic. Pick up Florence airport September 25, move to 12:00. Drop Fiumicino, move to October 11 around noon. Prepaid.

Drive times

Chianti to the coast about 3 hours. Coast to Cernobbio 2 hours 30. Como to the Dolomites 3 hours 15. Alpe di Siusi to Montepulciano 4 hours 45. Monteverdi to Porto Ercole 2 hours. Porto Ercole to Fiumicino 1 hour 45.

Pace

No departures before 11:00 unless you choose. One visit a day is the target, two the ceiling.
